info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Management API is designed to provide access to marketing campaign details based on specific parameters. This endpoint allows users to retrieve information about ongoing and past marketing campaigns by specifying a unique identifier. Typical consumers include marketing analysts and campaign managers who need to assess campaign performance and engagement metrics. With this API, businesses can leverage data to enhance marketing strategies, targeting efforts, and optimize future campaigns.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific prospect campaign by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific prospect campaign identified by its unique ID. It is useful for obtaining the current status and attributes of the campaign.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve campaign management details for a specific prospect, identified by the unique campaign ID. The parameters within the schema must be populated accurately to ensure that the request is processed correctly.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the prospect campaign details.

GetMarketingByParam1Request.description: A request body schema that represents the payload in JSON format for the campaign management operations.

targetSegmentId.description: Identifier for the target market segment associated with the campaign.

channelMix.description: List of channels used in the campaign.

startDate.description: Start date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.

endDate.description: End date of the campaign in ISO 8601 format.

campaignObjective.description: The main objective of the campaign.

controlGroupPercent.description: Percentage of the audience that will be part of the control group.

contactFrequencyCap.description: Maximum number of contacts allowed for each recipient during the campaign.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the campaign record.

version.description: Version number of the campaign details.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the campaign details were last updated.

GetMarketingByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for retrieving campaign management details.

amount.description: The total budget amount allocated for the campaign.

currency.description: The currency in which the budget is specified.

Budget.description: Schema representing the budget information for a campaign.

responseId.description: Unique identifier for the response associated with the campaign.

correlationId.description: Identifier used for tracking the correlation of requests.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp for when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: Geographic region where the processing of the campaign occurred.

Metadata.description: Schema containing metadata related to the campaign.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a bearer token for authentication. The token must be a JSON Web Token (JWT) that is sent in the `Authorization` header as a prefix 'Bearer'.
